lines.1: A refreshing morning on the way to school.
lines.2: I was commuting with Kinu as usual.
lines.5: 「Yo! It's everybody's Shin-san. I'm doing great!」
lines.6: Our classmates joined us one after another.
lines.8: 「The girls of Makoku just wouldn't let me go.」
lines.10: 「The name of the all-girl team at the ninja academy I belong to in my fantasies. I'm the only guy.」
lines.11: His fantasies were getting more elaborate by the day...
lines.12: 「Today I feel like tormenting Tsushima nice and slowly.」
lines.14: 「You're happy about it. Look, you're blushing.」
lines.15: I corrected Fukahire's nonsense and got teased by the Princess.
lines.20: 「Konoe again. Your timing really is terrible lately, Leo.」
lines.21: 「Well, don't let anything harsh she says get to you. You've got Subaru, right? Heh heh.」
lines.22: Why did he look so happy about that?
lines.24: Konoe approached without changing her expression.
lines.25: Her clean-cut features seemed to project the strength of her will.
lines.26: The scars from the violence she suffered long ago were gone.
lines.27: I was genuinely glad about that.
lines.30: Correction: it wasn't quite the "same old morning commute" after all.
lines.31: It was a little different now.
lines.32: Partly for Otome's sake, we had stopped openly fighting.
lines.33: That did not mean the emotional distance between us had closed.
lines.34: Still, being able to exchange a proper morning greeting was nice.
lines.35: 「What's going on here, Mr. Fukahire of the Samesuga household?」
lines.37: 「Ah... Leo is back on greeting terms with a cute girl, and for some reason I'm feeling anxious!」
lines.39: 「Hey, Nishizaki. What's up? Something funny happen?」
lines.41: 「Oh, I see. Now I understand everything.」
lines.42: 「You understood from one sound... These guys are no ordinary people.」
